Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im IT-Support, Field Service, Onsite Support oder einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit
Sehr gute praktische Kenntnisse rund um PCs, Notebooks und Windows-Systeme

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the intersection between research and data: people who think deeply about what conversational data is actually composed of, what makes data valuable, and how to best leverage that.

Conversational audio presents incredibly rich scientific, engineering, and infrastructure challenges that are orders of magnitude harder than working with text. In this role you'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and data teams to answer those questions rigorously and at scale. You'll care deeply about what makes conversational data difficult, you'll characterize it, and you'll shape the strategies that turn it into model gains. title: Virtual Bookkeeper
description:
About Strong Roots Accounting

Strong Roots Accounting is a small accounting firm based in Fort Worth, Texas, serving small businesses and nonprofits with accurate, reliable bookkeeping and financial insight. We are not a factory. We are not a revolving door. We are a close-knit, values-driven team that operates with intention - every client gets one point of contact, consistent communication, and work they can count on every single month.

We exist to be a collaborative partner to businesses and individuals, providing accurate, reliable insights that allow them to make informed decisions with confidence and grow. Our vision is bigger than bookkeeping: we are building something that creates meaningful opportunities for people to build long-lasting stability and confidence in their future.

We are growing - intentionally and carefully - and we are looking for the right person to grow with us.

This Is Who We Are

We operate by a set of values and principles that are non-negotiable. They are not posted on a wall and forgotten. They are how we show up every day.

Core Values:

•
Trust

•
Quality

•
Contribution

Our Principles:

•
Honesty and accuracy above all.

•
Be curious. Ask why. And solve problems.

•
Rapid, responsive, and reliable communication.

•
Repeatable processes are the only option.

If you read those and felt something - keep reading. If you read those and they felt like just words, this is not the right fit, and that is okay.

This Is Who We Are NOT Looking For

We are a small team doing meaningful work. There is no room for the following:

•
People who cut corners and hope no one notices

•
People who go quiet when things get hard

•
People who need to be micromanaged to deliver

•
People who treat accuracy as optional

•
People who are not genuinely curious about the work they do

•
People who are not committed to the client behind the numbers

If any of that describes you, we genuinely wish you well - just not here.

The Role

The person best suited for this job is organized, detail-oriented, and personable. If you like to put your headphones on and dive into the numbers, you'll love this job.

Our team gets to complete something from start to finish every day - there's real joy in putting your head down and checking tasks off one by one. But this role takes more than the obvious skills. The person who thrives here is caring: caring about the work itself, about what it means for the client, for their peers, and for the company as a whole. That caring is what drives someone to get the details right, ask the question instead of guessing, and take pride in a quality product. It also takes someone intrinsically motivated. We won't be standing over your shoulder - we trust you to hold yourself accountable and stay on track.

Strong Roots is the most mission-minded place many of our team members have ever worked. We care about our people first, and that shows up in the quality of our work, the strength of our client relationships, and the culture we've built together.

This is a remote, backend bookkeeping position supporting our Client Relationship Manager. You will not have direct contact with clients - your job is to execute the bookkeeping work accurately, quietly, and on time so our team can deliver a seamless experience on the client-facing side.

You will manage end-of-month reconciliations across approximately 30 small business and nonprofit client accounts. Work is assigned by our Client Relationship Manager, who will be your primary point of contact for priorities, questions, and feedback.

This role may be part-time or full-time - we are open to the right fit and will discuss arrangements with the right candidate.

•

•
Ensure client books are clean, consistent, and completed on time every month

• Pipeline-Generierung über Ads, Content und E-Mail als ein zusammenhängendes Marketingsystem, nicht als drei getrennte

Was dich hier erwartet

• Strategie und Priorisierung: Du baust Brand und Agentur-Marketing als System auf, entwickelst die Strategie hinter der Pipeline-Generierung und entscheidest, was zuerst passiert

• Ads: Du entwickelst Ad-Konzepte und gibst zu laufenden Kampagnen Feedback. Du verantwortest das Ergebnis, nicht die Klickarbeit

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE nur einmal. Du steuerst und koordinierst, produzierst aber nicht alles selbst. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

- You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

- Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

- You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

- You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

- Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

- Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately
